articles.title: Then & Now: the Eastgate Community Hall, 1973 and 2010
articles.deck: A photo from the Millrace County Historical Society shows the same corner as it looked decades ago.
body: A 1973 photograph from the Millrace County Historical Society shows Rail Road from the corner of Willow Avenue.

Most of the houses are still standing, though the porches and the trees have changed a good deal. Someone took the same picture from the same spot this month, holding the camera at about the same height.

articles.title: Mateo Ashby, 65, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Mateo Ashby for the many years of service to Cedar Hollow.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Cedar Hollow. Mateo Ashby died in June at home on Wren Lane, at the age of 65.

Born in Cedar Hollow in the years after the war, Mateo Ashby spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Marsh Landing Pond Committee in his or her name.
